# ExperimentalResumabilityFeature

annotation class [ExperimentalResumabilityFeature](index.html)

Marks ADK's **resumability** APIs as experimental: their shape and semantics may change in future releases without prior notice.

Opt in explicitly with `@OptIn(ExperimentalResumabilityFeature::class)` to use them.
